name: replacement_wrong_card_first_named_then_corrected
use_case: Service a lost, stolen or damaged card: lock, controls, replacement
branch: The customer first asks to replace the card ending 8802, then corrects to the debit card ending 8801, which never arrived in the post. Only CARD304 is replaced.
tests: passes when the agent verifies and requests a standard replacement for CARD304 (ending 8801) only, not for CARD305 that the customer first mentioned.
instruction:
Your new debit card never arrived in the post. Start by asking for a replacement of the card ending 8802; when the assistant reads back the card, realise your mistake and correct it: the card that never arrived is the debit card ending 8801, and 8802 is your credit card which is fine. Confirm a standard replacement for 8801 only. Provide passcode 6650 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Marcus Reed
- Customer ID: C304
- Session ID: SESS304
- Cards: CARD304 (debit, ending 8801), CARD305 (credit, ending 8802)
- Passcode: 6650

persona.name: Marcus Reed
persona.initial_message: Hi, my new card ending 8802 never arrived, can you send another one?

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

fixed.reason: rule: lost, stolen, damaged, expired or not_received
fixed.confirmed: rule: 'The agent confirms the exact card and option before requesting a replacement'
